messages:
Maya CSM: Hey team — Acadia (new onboarding) sent over their vendor security form + DPA checklist. They flagged SOC2 evidence and a network diagram as blockers for legal. Uploads here: https://redwood.internal/drive/acadia/onboard (view only)

Jon Eng: thanks. Do we know if they're planning hosted or private deployment?

Maya CSM: Hosted for now, could move to Dedicated later. Legal specifically asked for SOC2 Type II report, a controls-to-dataflow mapping, and confirmation of encryption at rest + KMS details.

Priya SecOps: We can share a SOC2 cover letter + a controls mapping for hosted. KMS note: for hosted we use AWS KMS with customer-segregated keys via strict IAM roles; for Private customers we support customer-managed keys. I'll pull the mapping and redact any sensitive items.

Jon Eng: re: network diagram — do they want infra-level CIDR/subnet details or a high-level service/data-flow diagram? I can draft both but need the ask clarified.

Maya CSM: Legal asked for a "network diagram" and a "data flow showing where PII/PHI touches Redwood systems". High-level is fine but must show ingress points, where KV cache/embeddings live, and retention boundaries.

Priya SecOps: Quick reminder: default hosted ingestion avoids storing raw PHI for embeddings unless explicitly configured. We'll call out data minimization, retention periods, and our incident notification SLA: https://redwood.internal/policies/incident-response

InfraBot: File uploaded by Priya: /files/acadia/controls-mapping-v1.pdf

Andre: timeline constraint — Acadia's procurement wants to close by EOW next week. Can we hit that if we turn these artifacts around quickly?

Jon Eng: I can get a first-draft diagram by Wed EOD. Will include both high-level flow and an appendix with optional infra details.

Priya SecOps: I'll drop the controls mapping today and the SOC2 cover letter by Tue morning. Will redact any customer-identifying artifacts and remove internal-only network details.

Maya CSM: Great. I'll tell Acadia we're expecting artifacts Tue/Wed and will confirm next steps. Also capturing product feedback: they asked about token-level cost breakdown for batch embeddings — tagging @Lena Product to follow up.

Lena Product: noted, I’ll coordinate separately. For this thread we should stick to security artifacts.

Maya CSM: Action items:
- Jon Eng: high-level network + data-flow diagram (Wed EOD)
- Priya SecOps: controls mapping (today) + SOC2 cover letter (Tue AM)
- Maya CSM: update Acadia procurement and collect signed DPA
- Andre: keep procurement pressure / extend if needed

Maya CSM: Any blockers? :slightly_smiling_face:

Jon Eng: none from my side.

Priya SecOps: none.

Maya CSM: Thanks all :thumbsup:
